trap-nonspeakable.notes: MATH/PROVENANCE FINDINGS (report, not fixed), four items. (1) DEAD-AND-DEPRECATED WITNESS: the block ends '**Witness:** confinement-lp.witness.json'. No such file exists under computations/; the only copy in the tree is computations/_deprecated/confinement-lp.witness.json (last touched by 230cdd113, 'decorating the Gram cannot break the confinement-LP degeneracy'). (2) THE DEPRECATED WITNESS DOES NOT REPRODUCE THE BLOCK'S NUMBER: its gram_eigenvalues are {-0.7408452101064132, 0.4139987135224257, 0.4281147970398734, 0.7408452101064141, 1.2820197506195954, 2.8930702013515126} - all six distinct, none zero - whereas the block asserts spec(G) = {lambda_+ x3, lambda_max, lambda_0, lambda_-} with lambda_- approx -0.855. The -0.855 and the triple-lambda_+ structure come from a DIFFERENT witness, computations/gram-h3-symbolic-regression.witness.json, whose spectrum I recomputed as {-0.85506726, 0.10179667, 0.85506726, 0.85506726, 0.85506726, 3.4769498}. (3) PIN AND CONVENTION: that deprecated witness records q0 = 1.1099785955541805, the OLD MUON value (a pin-currency defect, not a corrupt number), and z = 0.4993203340335982 = z_C = sqrt(q)/(q+1), the EXCISED convention C. The regression witness is also convention C (G[0][1] = 0.4993203341836944) but at the proton pin. Under the CANONICAL convention D the same object (computations/gram-matrix-dual.witness.json, z = 0.6126880371464652, proton pin) has spectrum {4.2303392, 0.7527021132519656 x3, 3.07e-17, -0.7527021132519656}: the block's lambda_- should read -0.7527, not -0.855, and only under D is the name 'lambda_0' literally correct (it is 0.1018, not zero, under C). (4) UNSUPPORTED COMPARATIVE: the mirror word's |Delta net| = 0.004 is called 'an order of magnitude worse', but the comparison target is 0.000 (against which no ratio is defined) and the block's own next bullet puts all other words above 0.01, i.e. 0.004 is 2.5x BETTER than that floor, not an order of magnitude worse. State what it is worse than, or drop the comparative.
